title: 专题：知识服务正确性（同步执行索引条件、恢复后重进索引、重建分页、权限过滤后补取、命中标题、嵌入分批）
body:
maintainer · os-bob · session_012dn2AecKpLaYkUtNRiqtby

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic parent). Source: maintainer. Key words (maintainer, 2026-11-24, this session): 「先立专题 ① 记录范围 AI 问询 ；⑤ 应用技能进入应用内 AI ，M0 那几项知识服务缺陷 也立专题，目前开发的策略是按专题派」「这几个专题任务用fable 审核之后立卡」「专题 ② 知识检索平台化 也一起立」. Reviewed by an independent Fable pass before filing.
Batch-of: 4 epics filed together on 2026-11-24 (this one, 「知识检索平台化」, 「记录范围 AI 问询」, cloud 「应用技能进入应用内 AI」).

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：修知识服务里已发布行为的缺陷。知识源声明了索引条件（比如只索引现行版本），但记录变更时不看它，失效记录还能被搜到；回收站恢复的记录不会重新进索引；全量重建一次把整张表读进内存；按权限过滤后不补，能看的记录少的人搜不到；命中结果的标题只认名为 title 的字段；嵌入时所有文本一次发出去，不分批。
- 不做：新的接口、知识源写成元数据、切分、向量存储、按记录返回（在「知识检索平台化」专题里）。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Children

| Milestone | Child | Blocked-by | Lane |
|---|---|---|---|
| M0 | 1. (filed below) event sync honours the source `where`; a restored record re-enters the index | #36650 | server |
| M0 | 2. (filed below) `reindexSource` pages instead of one unbounded read | 1 | server |
| M0 | 3. (filed below) search refills after the permission filter | #36839 | server |
| M0 | 4. (filed below) hit title from the object's display field | 1, #36839 | server |
| M0 | 5. (filed below) `embedder-openai` sends every input in one request | none | plugins |
| later | 6. sync-failure counts per source — row only: filed once a named reader exists (the reconcile work in 「知识检索平台化」 is the expected one) | — | — |

All five touch `service-knowledge` or `embedder-openai`; 1–4 touch the same file as #36650 (PR #36823) and #36839, hence the edges.

## Rulings that bound every child

- No new adapter-contract members (list, drop, capabilities, typed filters) here; they wait for the knowledge-platform ADR. A child that finds it needs one stops and says so on the card.
- The count of hits removed by the permission filter is never returned to the caller; logs only.
- `aiExposed` stays enforced at the tool layer (#36650), not in `IKnowledgeService.search`.
- `IKnowledgeService.search` keeps its public signature and return type.

## Done when

All children closed; `service-knowledge` and `embedder-openai` tests cover each fix.

Related, not children: #36650 and PR #36823 (MCP knowledge tool, same file), #36839 (in flight, same function), #33933 (knowledge settings only where the service is mounted; the 2026-11-15 ruling that knowledge is not a focus is superseded by the maintainer's 2026-11-24 words above — that card's own change stays valid).
Reader: the server lane for `service-knowledge`; the plugins lane for child 5.
Dedupe: `knowledge where event sync is:open` 4 (none on this mechanism) · `handleRecordUpsert` 4 (all closed: #20573, #4672, #20288, #14646) · `reindexSource` 3 (all closed) · `knowledge search permission filter topK` 1 (#36839, different mechanism) · `embedder-openai` 159 / `embedder batch` 117 (none open on this).
